raw:
Seraphel stays beside the empty chair and turns the slim book so you can see its faded blue title: *The Salt Road Courier*.

“*The Salt Road Courier.* A merchant’s journey gone wrong.  
He falls into a river twice, then curses it all day long.

“Each inconvenience is a tragedy; each innkeeper, a foe.  
I marked the ferry chapter. That is where the worst complaints grow.”
